head: 4b0016fe0c9af845b7413a2ec9ed2806f499182f
summary:
I re-validated the merged tree, 4b0016f: uat d0446e3 with SL-076, plus SL-077 build attempt 3. That is the tree the merge out will produce. `git diff --stat 98faaae 4b0016f -- src` is empty, so the product code is the same code my first validate ran and mutated. What moved under it is test-only:
- SL-076 changed tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 (Invoke-HarnessRaw now reads only the leaf of the kept scratch path) and added tests/bugs/SL-076-ScratchKeptPath.Tests.ps1.
- Build 3 widened the path-API name list in fitness.yaml and ArchitectureRulesTests.
- Build 3 also made the Kernel32 count Fact read its patterns from the twin Fact's source.

**Real hardware.** I published FsAnalyser.App.exe fresh from 4b0016f and started it through eng/read-window.ps1 -DefaultErrorMode, so the process error mode was 0x0 and it did not inherit this shell's 0x8003.
- E:\ and F:\ are empty removable card-reader slots (Removable, IsReady=False). Both ended RootUnreadable with rootError 21 ('The device is not ready. (Windows error 21)'), in 8–9 ms core time.
- E:\some\folder gave the same result in 7 ms.
- Each run exited 0 in 1.3–1.5 s. No run timed out, so nothing blocked on a disk prompt.
- A temp NTFS control tree Completed (1 file, 2 folders, 5 bytes, 8 on disk).

**Where the two slices meet.** Everything that exercises SL-076 and SL-077 together held:
- All 14 RuleCases cases (C-001 to C-014) ran with the engine, in 303 s.
- SL-076's bug test passed across all shapes.
- The rules harness recorded 56 of 56 rows AS-RECORDED, with 0 stray hits. As on every run, 1 import rule is NOT RUN because the scratch copy has no code graph.
- rules-parity says AGREE (12 facts, 29 patterns) under both pwsh and Windows PowerShell.
- Fitness: all 62 rules hold.
- The full default suite passed 414 of 414.

**Mutation.** I planted `"FindFirstStreamW"`, one of build 3's five new names, in Kernel32.cs. The count Fact failed and named that line. That shows O-026 (the new names are counted) and O-027 (the Fact takes its patterns from the twin's source, with no third copy). I restored the file with an identical hash, and the 26 rule and guard Facts passed again.

**The loop.** Build attempts 2 and 3 both came from code-review findings, changed no src, and each widened the same enumerated name list. That is a loop on rule machinery, not progress on behaviour. The texts now say the list is not exhaustive. Any further widening belongs to a person's decision on the process-wide SetErrorMode follow-up, not another lap here. This validate attempt only re-judged a tree that moved under a sound verdict (STALE).

**What the report left me to assume.** The bug report was only a title, so I kept the design's assumption: the box comes from CreateFileW on a path on a drive with no media, and with the flag set that call returns 21. The real runs confirm the second half. The counterfactual is still not shown: the pre-fix exe has never been run on E:\ to prove this reader raises the box without the fix, because that would put a modal box on the person's screen. Criterion 14 (handle-based calls after media is pulled mid-scan) was scoped out by the design and not checked.

checks.what: Whole-drive C:\ scan through the published exe (criterion 13's 'equally a whole-drive C:\ scan')
checks.evidence: A C:\ scan runs SizeProbe on all 16 logical processors for minutes, which breaks the half-the-processors limit on this shared machine. NTFS root, subfolder and probe opens are covered by the 414-test suite; the drive-root shape is covered by E:\ and F:\.

checks.what: Handle-based calls after media is pulled mid-scan (criterion 14)
checks.evidence: Needs someone to remove a card physically mid-scan, and the design scoped it out (C-014). It is an open question for a person.

criteria.criterion: 1. open the scan root: whole-tree scan of a temp NTFS folder; the root's listing open is guard call 1 on the scan thread
criteria.how: The full suite passed 414/414 on 4b0016f, including EveryFolderTheScanOpensIsOpenedWithTheBoxOff (call 1 reads 0x1). src is identical to the tree where mutant A (no `using` in Open) killed it. Real: the published exe's root open on E:\ and F:\ returned 21 into RootUnreadable without blocking. The engine's repro (O-001) is on record and I do not re-judge it.

criteria.criterion: 2. size a file with SizeProbe: a probe worker thread, and a direct SizeProbe.Probe on the test thread
criteria.how: AProbeOnThisThreadOpensWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack (3 presets) and ProbesOnSeveralThreadsAtOnceEachGiveTheirThreadItsModeBack pass in the 414. src is unchanged from the tree where mutants A and B killed both.

criteria.criterion: 3. open a nested folder during the scan (OpenDirectory for non-root folders)
criteria.how: EveryFolderTheScanOpensIsOpenedWithTheBoxOff (root\a\sub; exactly 4 scan-thread calls read 0x1) passes on the merged tree.

BothRoutesOfAFolderOpenRunWithTheBoxOff passes: KeptLastAccess is true on one fixture and false on the other (FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES denied), each reads 0x1 inside and 0x2 after. src unchanged since I read the scope placement in attempt 1.

criteria.criterion: 5. give the thread its mode back: preset 0x0 before a direct Probe
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 0 passes in the 414; mutants A and B killed it on identical src.

criteria.criterion: 6. give the thread its mode back: preset SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX 0x2
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 2 passes (exactly 0x1 inside, 0x2 after).

criteria.criterion: 7. give the thread its mode back: caller already has 0x1
criteria.how: The Theory case preset 1 and NestedScopesUnwindInOrder pass. Mutant B killed the nested Fact on identical src, so LIFO restore is shown, not assumed.

criteria.criterion: 8. restore on a failed open (access denied err 5, missing path)
criteria.how: AFailedOpenRanWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack passes. Real: error 21 on E:\, F:\ and E:\some\folder went through Open's failure path to RootUnreadable in the published exe.
ACancelledOrThrowingOpenGivesTheModeBack passes: a cancel during the root open, a refusal because Cancel came first, and an exception inside the bracket. Each reads 0x1 inside and restores 0x2.

Checked in the form review m3 accepted: 4 dedicated threads run probes concurrently, and each thread's mode returns to its baseline. The literal 'reused ThreadPool thread' shape is not tested, by design, because it is nondeterministic.

criteria.criterion: 11. TryGetVolumeUsed after moving onto the shared scope
criteria.how: TheVolumeReadRunsWithTheBoxOffAndGivesTheModeBack passes. Mutant C (scope removed from TryGetVolumeUsed) killed it on identical src in attempt 1.

criteria.criterion: 12. counting rules through the guarded Open (links, hardlinks, on-disk size, long paths, unreadable folders)
criteria.how: The full default suite ran 414/414 with 0 skipped on the merged tree. The counting-rule tests are in the default filter; only the Network and Cloud traits are excluded.

criteria.criterion: 13. open a drive with no media (ERROR_NOT_READY 21 into Open's failure path); whole-drive vs folder scan
criteria.how: Real: the published exe from 4b0016f, launched with process error mode 0x0, scanned E:\ and F:\ (whole drive) and E:\some\folder (folder). All three gave RootUnreadable, rootError 21, EXIT 0 in 1.3–1.5 s, and no run timed out. Caveats: no whole-drive C:\ scan through the exe (load limit), and the pre-fix counterfactual is not shown.

criteria.criterion: 14. handle-based calls after media is removed mid-scan (listing, GetFileInformationByHandleEx, GetVolumeInformationByHandleW)
criteria.how: Scoped out by the design (C-014). It needs physical media removal mid-scan; whether to bring it into scope is an open question for a person.

obligations.evidence: On 4b0016f, both yaml patterns and both ArchitectureRulesTests patterns hold CreateFileTransacted[AW]?, FindFirstFileName[AW]?, FindFirstStream[AW]?, GetFileInformationByName and GetCompressedFileSize[AW]? (diff 5c2d1ff..4b0016f). The texts now say the rule holds only the names it lists. rules-parity AGREE at 29 patterns. Planting "FindFirstStreamW" in Kernel32.cs failed the count Fact, naming that line.

The count Fact's own `const string names` literal is gone. FactPatterns reads PathOpensGoOnlyThroughTheGuardedOpen's two verbatim patterns out of ArchitectureRulesTests.cs, the copy rules-parity compares with the yaml. The FindFirstStreamW plant was caught, and FindFirstStream exists in the test tree only in the twin Fact's source. After restoring (identical hash), the 26 rule and guard Facts passed.

Carried from attempt 1 on byte-identical src (git diff 98faaae..4b0016f -- src is empty). The Facts that carry it (presets 0/2/1, failed, cancelled/refused/throwing, multi-thread, nested) all pass in the 414 on the merged tree.

not_reached: Whether the pre-fix exe (uat 14acea3) actually raises the 'There is no disk in the drive' box on E:\ or F:\ when launched with -DefaultErrorMode. Without it, 'no box after the fix' is not shown to be caused by the fix, since this card reader might return 21 silently either way. A person present to dismiss the box can run `eng/read-window.ps1 -Exe <pre-fix exe> -Root E:\ -TimeoutSec 60 -DefaultErrorMode` once.
The scan thread's own error mode inside the real exe during the empty-drive open. Only the launch-time process mode (0x0) and the outcome (error 21, no hang) were observed.
An Explorer (double-click) launch on the empty drive. The runs used CREATE_DEFAULT_ERROR_MODE, which the risk spike found gives the same 0x0 process mode as an Explorer launch.
A whole-drive C:\ scan through the published exe after the fix. It was not run because of the 16-thread probe load for minutes on a shared machine.
Media pulled mid-scan, so that handle-based calls hit a no-disk condition (criterion 14, C-014). This needs physical removal and was scoped out.
Other removable hardware (USB floppy, an optical drive with no disc, other card readers). Only this PC's two empty card-reader slots were reached.
Windows 10: only Windows 11 build 26200 was run.
The harness's individual F24/F25/F26/P24 rows were not read (the output was filtered to its last 30 lines). Only the 56/56 AS-RECORDED, 0-stray summary was seen.
